div.span: Each model at its shipped defaults; cost per solved task at list prices, priced as a customer is billed (5-minute cache expiry). Blue marks Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Fable 5.1.
Left: 478-problem subset; two runs each for Opus 5, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5, and Sonnet 5.5, three for Fable 5, and one each for Sonnet 4.6 and Fable 5.1.
Right: 74 tasks on Claude Managed Agents, two runs per model; the Fable and Sonnet models and Opus 5.5 were not run on Terminal-Bench 3.
